Pipes 2.1.5 Steady-State Simulation Solution Process BlendPATH applies the Newton-Raphson method on Equation 2.28 to determine a solution to Equation 2.27 (Osi- adacz 1987). This approach is adapted from Lu, Pesch, and Benigni (2022) to simulate the steady-state solution. The Newton-Raphson method is a stationary iterative method that approximates a nonlinear system of equations into a linear system to determine an iterative solution.
